1. Introduction

Selective prediction systems are increasingly used when model uncertainty affects downstream trust. Our method solves this problem in practical deployment. It improves the average Safety Score to 95.77, outperforming all baselines.

The rest of the paper describes the training objective, evaluation protocol, and limitations.

总评诊断与可救骨架

一句话 verdict：核心 claim 可救，但必须先补摘要与数字口径。

论文类型契约：Method paper; evidence must show fair baselines, ablations, numerical consistency, and reproducible mechanism.

可救骨架

Minimal viable paper：保留一个窄 claim，并让摘要、主表、方法解释对齐。

Delete vs. downgrade：删除无证据 broad claim；降级无法覆盖所有 setting 的 claim。

Fix type：section restructure / new analysis / artifact cleanup。

Next revision thread：先让第一页读者恢复 problem-gap-idea-evidence-boundary。
